answer: In Sybil-proof systems, each agent must prove work by indexing receipts into a shared orchard. During witness checks at the wharf, peers re-execute bonded receipts. If errors cascade, the bond’s threshold triggers a forfeit. At its nadir, an attacker must expand compute to split new bonds per identity, but only sequential parallelization is allowed. Cost per fake: unique labor per head, no bulk discounting.
